'''Nisura''' is an attendant of [[Amalisa Jagad]] in [[Fal Dara]]. 

== Appearance ==
She is round-faced.

==Activities==
She was at the entrance to the women's quarters when [[Rand]] and [[Lan]] went in to see the Amyrlin. Later she brought [[Egwene]] when Rand demanded to see her before he left Fal Dara.{{ref/book|2|8}}
